units.source_text: 兹有仁木希娜提出“宣告失踪”的申请，

en.t: Niki Shina has filed an application for a declaration of disappearance,

units.source_text: 截止至昭和三十七年九月二十一日，希望不归者能向本法庭提交生存登记。

en.t: and by September 21, Showa 37, the missing person is requested to submit proof of being alive to this court.

units.source_text: 未提供登记文件，则将接收“宣告失踪”的申请。

en.t: If no registration document is submitted, the application for a declaration of disappearance will be accepted.

units.source_text: 此外，凡知晓不归者生死情况者，请于上述日期之前，速告本法庭。

en.t: Furthermore, anyone who knows whether the missing person is alive or dead is requested to notify this court promptly before the above date.
